objective: Preserve the full push/pull/fetch/rebase/merge/PR squash/cherry-pick/checkout speed, fresh Graph, stability and minimum-resource goal.
change: Stream the exact legacy UTF-8 operation-index digest and unmerged stages. Retain safe read retries with fresh per-attempt state and read-only execution gates.

method.indexScope: Actual Native index capture and Undo-plan validation, without100000-file checkout. Forced GC before each capture is benchmark-only.
method.processScope: Optional observer wraps the actual benchmark Node after source archive/build. wait4 CPU includes that completed Node and children plus fixture setup and validation. RSS is a sampled sum for visible owned descendants; shared pages may count repeatedly and short children/peaks may be missed. Observer/ps excluded.
method.matrixScope: Nine real service operations with production HTML/CSP/headless renderer; VS Code transport is replaced. These are service-to-renderer flows, not actual button/picker latency. Two runs/source are exploratory.
method.externalNetwork: Owned local bare receiver only; no GitHub latency measurement.
method.nativeSafety: Existing Native ref/HEAD/operation/index checks, fsmonitor=false and read time limits remain. No new runtime timer or Git query.
